title: Interactive actions host
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-cli interactions passes; pdfxi interactions audits real catalog/page/annotation /AA actions, resolves GoTo destinations, reports dangerous actions and fails with --strict; MEDIA-005 moves to verified.
notes: Hosts pdfxi_render::actions over real /AA dictionaries and runs the CLI on a 16 MiB worker stack so the growing clap tree cannot exhaust the main-thread stack.
